description:
A photo looks right at first glance... until every slice turns your plan around.

You know the finished image is in there somewhere. The fun is spotting the clues, turning each piece, and watching the scene click back into place.

This is a casual rotating picture puzzle where one image is split into slices. Rotate the slices to restore the original view, then aim for a faster clear time to earn more stars.

・Look over the sliced image
・Rotate each slice to the correct angle
・Complete the picture
・Try to clear faster for up to three stars

No trivia, no complicated rules—just visual focus, quick decisions, and that satisfying moment when everything lines up.

Play a stage whenever you want a short puzzle break, or replay stages to chase a better time.

Button controls and touch controls are supported.
